markets.name: Belmont, NC Farmers Market
markets.about: The Belmont, NC Farmers Market is a Thursday market meeting in Stowe Park, the heart of our town. We feature local farmers, growers, bakers, makers and dog treats. We have a monthly community table, guest chef and a Jr. Entrepreneur program.
